{"fragment": true, "screens": [{"tag": "screen", "attrs": {"backgroundColor": "md_transparent", "flags": "wfNoBorder", "name": "SortbyChoiceBox", "position": "fill", "title": "", "resolution": "1920,1080"}, "children": [{"tag": "widget", "attrs": {"backgroundColor": "md_surface_container_high", "font": "md_title_small_emphasized", "foregroundColor": "md_primary", "halign": "left", "position": "15,3", "render": "Label", "size": "250,40", "source": "Title", "transparent": "1", "valign": "center", "zPosition": "2"}, "children": null, "text": null}, {"tag": "widget", "attrs": {"backgroundColor": "md_surface", "font": "md_title_medium_emphasized", "foregroundColor": "md_secondary", "name": "text", "position": "15,15", "size": "880,0", "valign": "center"}, "children": null, "text": null}, {"tag": "widget", "attrs": {"backgroundColor": "md_surface", "font": "md_body_medium", "foregroundColor": "md_primary", "name": "description", "position": "0,0", "size": "570,0", "transparent": "1"}, "children": null, "text": null}, {"tag": "widget", "attrs": {"backgroundColor": "md_surface", "enableWrapAround": "1", "itemCornerRadius": "6", "itemHeight": "45", "name": "list", "position": "525,330", "scrollbarMode": "showNever", "scrollbarSliderBorderColor": "md_surface_container_lowest", "scrollbarSliderBorderWidth": "0", "scrollbarSliderForegroundColor": "md_on_surface_variant", "scrollbarWidth": "5", "size": "869,495", "transparent": "1", "zPosition": "2"}, "children": null, "text": null}, {"tag": "applet", "attrs": {"type": "onLayoutFinish"}, "children": null, "text": "from enigma import ePoint, eSize, getDesktop, gRGB, BT_ALPHABLEND
from Components.Label import Label
from Components.Pixmap import Pixmap
from Tools.Directories import resolveFilename, SCOPE_CURRENT_SKIN
from Tools.LoadPixmap import LoadPixmap
from skin import parseRadius, parseColor, parseFont
font = parseFont("md_title_small_emphasized", ((1, 1), (1, 1)))
self.textRenderer = Label("")
self.textRenderer.GUIcreate(self.instance)
self.textRenderer.resize(1920,40)
self.textRenderer.move(-1920,-40)
self.textRenderer.instance.setFont(font)
self.textRenderer.text = self["Title"].text

titleSize = self.textRenderer.getSize()
textsize = self["text"].getSize()
textHeight = textsize[1]
textpos = self["text"].instance.position()
if textpos.x() < 0 and textpos.y() < 0: 
 textHeight = 0
self["text"].move(20, 55)
descriptionHeight = 0
if bool(self.list) and any([(True if len(x[0]) > 2 and x[0][2] and isinstance(x[0][2], str) else False) for x in self.list]):
 descriptionHeight = 75
count = len(self.list)
count, scrollbar = (10, self["list"].instance.getScrollbarWidth() + 5) if count > 10 else (count, 0)
offset = self["list"].l.getItemSize().height() * count
wsizex = max(max(self["list"].instance.getMaxItemTextWidth(), textsize[0]), titleSize[0] + 30) + 10 + 30
self["text"].resize(wsizex - 40, textHeight)
textsize = self["text"].getSize()
textHeight = textsize[1]
self["text"].resize(wsizex - 40, textHeight)
textPadding = 0
if textHeight > 0:
 textPadding = 10
wsizey = textHeight + textPadding + offset + descriptionHeight + 60 + 104
if descriptionHeight > 0:
 wsizey += 10
# move and resize elements
titleMargin = 10
for titleRenderer in self.renderer:
 if getattr(titleRenderer, "source", None) is self["Title"] and titleRenderer.instance:
 titleRenderer.instance.move(ePoint(titleMargin, 3))
 titleRenderer.instance.resize(eSize(wsizex - 2 * titleMargin, 40))
self["description"].move(20, textHeight + textPadding + 60 + offset + 10)
self["description"].resize(wsizex - 40, descriptionHeight)
self["list"].move(15, textHeight + textPadding + 60)
self.instance.resize(eSize(*(wsizex, wsizey)))
# resize list
self["list"].resize(wsizex - 30, offset)
# center window
width, height = getDesktop(0).size().width(), getDesktop(0).size().height()
wintlcpos = ePoint((width - wsizex) // 2, (height - wsizey) // 2)
self.instance.move(wintlcpos)"}, {"tag": "applet", "attrs": {"type": "onLayoutFinish"}, "children": null, "text": "from enigma import ePoint, eSize
from Components.Label import Label
from skin import parseRadius, parseColor
wsizex = self.instance.size().width()
wsizey = self.instance.size().height() - 15
radiusBLayer, edgeValueBLayer = parseRadius("16")
radiusTLayer, edgeValueTLayer = parseRadius("14")
self["blayer"] = Label()
self["blayer"].GUIcreate(self.instance)
self["blayer"].instance.setCornerRadius(radiusBLayer, edgeValueBLayer)
self["blayer"].instance.resize(eSize(wsizex, wsizey))
self["blayer"].instance.setBackgroundColor(parseColor("md_surface_container_high"))
self["blayer"].instance.move(ePoint(0, 0))
self["blayer"].setZPosition(-7)
self["tlayer"] = Label()
self["tlayer"].GUIcreate(self.instance)
self["tlayer"].instance.setCornerRadius(radiusTLayer, edgeValueTLayer)
self["tlayer"].instance.resize(eSize(wsizex - 4, wsizey - 47 - 62))
self["tlayer"].instance.setBackgroundColor(parseColor("md_surface"))
self["tlayer"].instance.move(ePoint(2, 47))
